2259386.note: The Georgia Melodians, Volume Two 1924 - 1926. Title states the span and the notes repeat it: "Recorded in New York, 1924-1926". 1977 pressing, no master year, so it filed under 1970s.

11946830.note: George Gershwin, Rhapsody In Blue / Un Américain À Paris. The two sides are the whole record: An American In Paris, composed 1928, and Rhapsody In Blue, composed 1924. No recording or issue year is given anywhere on the release, so this decade is the composition period, not a recording date.

2737750.note: Django Reinhardt, Le Quintette Du Hot Club De France. The Quintette's sides run c. 1934-1939; Discogs dates both the pressing and the master 1984, which is this compilation's own issue.

3538894.note: Benny Goodman, 1935-1936 The Original Sounds Of The Swing Era Vol. 6. Title states the recording years; 1978 pressing of a 1977 reissue series.

4089618.note: Benny Goodman, The Famous 1938 Carnegie Hall Jazz Concert. Title dates the concert; Discogs' 1950 master year is the first LP issue of it, and 1970 is this pressing.

4132446.note: Various, 20 Rock'n Roll Hits. The tracklist is dominated by mid-to-late-1950s rock'n'roll — Roll Over Beethoven 1956, Rock Around The Clock 1954, Whole Lotta Shakin' Goin' On 1957, Bo Diddley 1955, Good Golly Miss Molly 1958 — alongside a handful of early-1960s sides; the labels state ℗ 1956-1969. This is the dominant era of a compilation that spans several, not a single date. Nothing on the release dates the pressing, so it filed under Unknown.

10829082.note: Nina Simone, The Hits. Sleeve notes date every side: December 1957 through June 1961, twelve of the sixteen tracks recorded 1957-1959. 2017 pressing with no master year, so it filed under 2010s.

11339741.note: Duke Ellington, Blues In Orbit. Sleeve notes give recording dates for all four tracks: 2 February to 12 March 1959. Issued 1960, so it filed one decade late.
